definition:
Declination is the angular distance of a direction north or south of the celestial equator, measured along a celestial meridian. It is the celestial latitude.

It ranges from -90° at the South Celestial Pole to +90° at the North Celestial Pole, with 0° at the celestial equator.

Abbreviation: dec; Symbol: δ
Description: A star is located at a declination of N° on the celestial sphere.

Together with Right Ascension (RA), declination specifies a direction on the celstial sphere.
